description: This file defines the DayOfWeekField class within the Cron namespace. It extends AbstractField and handles evaluation and validation of day-of-week cron expressions, including special constructs like 'L', '#', and ranges.

classes.name: DayOfWeekField
classes.description: A class that models the 'day of week' field in a cron expression, providing methods to evaluate if a date satisfies the cron criteria, validate the expression, and increment dates accordingly.

methods.name: isSatisfiedBy
methods.description: Checks if the given date matches the specified day-of-week value, supporting special syntax like '?', 'L', '#', and ranges.

methods.name: increment
methods.description: Increments or decrements the date by one day, adjusting the time to the start or end of the day based on the 'invert' flag.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the given cron expression segment for the day-of-week field against allowed patterns, including ranges, step values, and special characters.

methods.name: convertLiterals
methods.description: Converts day-of-week string literals like SUN, MON, etc., into their numeric equivalents 0-6.
